geometryConstruction.circle: One stationary closed contour reconstructed from the eight source cubic pieces.
geometryConstruction.carrier: One canonical finite diagonal parallelogram with the source horizontal end caps, translated along its own diagonal; Carrier loop repeats the same path three times.
geometryConstruction.compositing: Two instance-unique luminance masks retain the circle/carrier XOR interaction with separately controlled fills. Every repeated carrier has paired cut and ink transforms; current presets give the circle and line the same neutral tone.
intentionalDifferences: Two masks produce different edge antialiasing from the canonical single compound path. Current presets use equal neutral circle and line colors; no pixel-identical assembled raster claim.
Original registration marks, the echo variant’s dot field and transient bar outlines are additional treatment elements.
The carrier keeps its diagonal angle and moves along that same down-left axis; the circle remains stationary.

Gravity pass, Magnetic catch, Signal fall and Ratchet descent fade the carrier ink and its circle cut together at the cycle boundary. Return stroke reverses without fading; Carrier loop exchanges only offscreen copies without fading at saved responsive sizes.

motion.driver: Shared SVG animation clock; no WebGL context, distance atlas or image buffer.
motion.stillPhaseScope: The default still pose and initial Preview pose are assembled in all six variants, with no transient echo outlines. Carrier loop retains offscreen repeated copies at positive Travel.
motion.intentionalDifference: Motion uses authored easing and damped oscillation curves rather than a physical rigid-body simulation.
motion.pauseAndSuspension: Pause/Play retains the current phase. Offscreen, hidden and reduced-motion states suspend ongoing animation.
motion.coordination: One active Canvas SVG study or two active Preview SVG studies; the SVG clock yields these motion slots to visible active WebGL studies.

axis.direction: down-left along the finite carrier’s own diagonal
axis.translation: dx=(axis.x/axis.y)*y; dy=y. LG-05–07 retain their timing and travel amount; all added carrier copies use the same axis.

travelSemantics.singleCarrier: Travel scales the excursion for Gravity pass, Magnetic catch, Signal fall, Ratchet descent and Return stroke.
travelSemantics.conveyor: For conveyor, positive Travel controls repeat spacing and distance per cycle (1400+1000*Travel); zero freezes one assembled carrier.

profiles.drop: Down-left descent with an assembled hold.
profiles.echo: Descent with two collinear transient echoes.
profiles.ratchet: Discrete monotone advances alternate with intermediate and assembled holds.
profiles.pendulum: Reciprocal travel pauses at the assembled mark and reverses at outer turnarounds.
profiles.conveyor: An opaque three-carrier train advances at constant speed; repeat spacing and distance per cycle are 1400+1000*Travel. Travel zero leaves one assembled carrier.
